lesson.title: What one step looks like
lesson.skill: Read a diagram of an equation the way you would read a sentence about it.
lesson.missionLink: Your mission is full of problems that look balanced and are not. This is the picture of what balanced means.

primarySource.why: It draws the balance with the weights still on it.

content.text: An equation is a claim that two sides weigh the same. Here is what that looks like before you start moving anything.

blocks.source: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 120" role="img"><line x1="20" y1="80" x2="220" y2="80" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="40" y="40" width="60" height="40" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="140" y="40" width="60" height="40" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><text x="70" y="65" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12">2x + 3</text><text x="170" y="65" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12">11</text></svg>
blocks.alt: A balance with 2 unknown weights on one side
blocks.caption: Whatever you add to one side, you add to the other.
